interface.shortDescription: Adaptive Research, Plan, Implement, Audit, and Code Review workflows for AI coding agents.
interface.longDescription: RPI Stack provides an adaptive 6-skill workflow system for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Google Antigravity / Gemini CLI. Features adaptive depth (Fast-Path for bugfixes, Deep-Path for multi-step features), smart clarification with trade-off recommendations, adversarial quality gates, pluggable stack profiles (Flutter, Frontend Web, Backend API, Scripts), and behavioral guardrails.
defaultPrompt: Use rpi to implement this feature.
Use research before modifying this architecture.
Use code-review to review my git diff.
